name: capstone-multimode-app
//: Module 08 capstone: ONE Next.js app with three modes (Transcribe | Translate | Assist).
This is a Node project (not a Python uv project). Install with `npm install`, run with `npm run dev`.
Version pins use ^ (caret) lower bounds so `npm install` fetches the latest compatible release,
then package-lock.json (written by npm install) locks the exact tree for reproducible installs.
Commit package-lock.json so a classmate gets the identical dependency tree.
